items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15

ctx.x: Tenor sax most of the time.

Yeah, well you had to play that with the other three instruments you see. Of course I featured the clarinet. And so I left the boat, made a little trip and I came back home. Oh I think I was married then. And so Dewey, he had a little job, so he sent him, so I went to play with Dewey. Went back to St. Louis, stayed up there close to two years I believe. I had to come back home, to the loud a little bit. I worked with whoever, Larry. And we did pretty nice.
How long have you been teaching music now too?
